dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: We've also taken up some of the setup work for this Irodori Festival here at Sailing Breeze.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Not only that, we've also gotten ourselves a collaboration with the light novel "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?". We'll start selling it once the festival opens, so please wait patiently!
